title: Liza Marcos joins Melania Trump, other spouses in coalition luncheon

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos joined United States First Lady Melania Trump and the spouses of other world leaders at the “Fostering the Future Together” luncheon in New York City. “Fostering the Future Together” is a global coalition of first spouses and leaders launched by Trump that focuses on empowering children through technology and education. In a social media post, Araneta-Marcos said she was “happy” to join fellow first ladies at the luncheon on Sept. 22, who she said all share the same hope and care for children.
